newsitem.title: USA: Option Care signs five managed-care pacts.
newsitem.headline: Option Care signs five managed-care pacts.

text.p: Option Care Inc, which provides home health-care services, on Friday said it signed agreements to provide services at the homes of members of five managed-care organizations.
Three of the five agreements are for comprehensive home home-care services, including infusion therapies, respiratory therapies, home medical equipment and home health services.
A fourth agreement, with a start-up Medicare Risk plan in Ohio, is for home health and infusion services.
The remaining agreement offers infusion services to more than 4.5 million eligible members.
The value of the contracts was not disclosed.
